artboards.title: Auth — log in / sign up / check email

annotations.text:
REDESIGN DIRECTION
Light white / blue, in the spirit of projectparallel.com — clinical precision, modern tech elegance.

• Paper white + one cool off-white section fill
• A single blue accent (#2563EB), no second colour on marketing
• IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono (mono stays for labels & data)
• 4px spacing base, 8/12px radii, soft low shadows
• Hairline rules instead of glass panels

MOTION
The cinematic Three.js scene is gone. The hero now carries a pale coordinate lattice and one locus curve that draws in over ~3s then rests, with three nodes on a slow drift. Everything stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

PLATFORM
Same information architecture as today — sidebar shell, XP/streak, dashboard instrumentation, gated lessons. Re-skinned to the light system: white cards on a cool ground, blue-monochrome charts, active nav in blue-tint.
This sheet is the build spec. When the direction is signed off I implement it against these exact tokens, component states, and motion rules — replacing app/globals.css and app/platform.css.
